name: unysonplus-animation-studio
description: Unyson+ Animation Studio: timeline motion graphics for the web, exported as plain HTML.

scripts.build:player: npm run build -w packages/player && node scripts/archive-player.mjs
scripts.dev: npm run build:player && npm run dev -w apps/studio
scripts.build: npm run build:player && npm run build -w apps/studio
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/player && npm run typecheck -w apps/studio
